subject: af-con
title: AF.CON.------CUL.SOLD.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-4 (Underlying Philosophical Basis, Level Two), the section where Braxton turns from particular cultures back to the universal philosophical question of how creativity functions cosmically across all of them. (C)AF-CON (affinity convergence) is crossed with CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). The diagram poses: when affinity convergence is itself crossed (the (c) prefix marking it as already in a crossing relation), what does its relationship to culture solidification actually look like? Two upstream feeds: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) → C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) → AF-CON; and CULT-SOLD → AF-CON directly. A separate chain runs PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) → MT-IMP (multi-implications) → TRS (transition), with TRS routing into CULT-SOLD, T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → EXP-CONT (expansion condition), and PROG-SIGN (progressional significance), and CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) feeding TRS. Structural argument: affinity convergence is constituted both downstream of social-reality-dynamics-via-culture-attitude and upstream of culture-solidification — a node *between* lived reality and the formed culture. Transition is the active hub where multi-implications, cross-transfer definitions, time-continuum implications and progressional significance all meet, with culture solidification as one of its outputs.
